narrative:
Short impact summary

Smith, Turgot, and the ‘Four Stages’ Theory (1977), published by Springer Nature, has been cited 61 times — enough that OpenAlex puts it in the top 1% of works in its field and year.

Full narrative

Smith, Turgot, and the ‘Four Stages’ Theory by Ronald L. Meek was published by Springer Nature in 1977. It is part of the Smith, Marx, & After series. Conceptually, the work connects to Materialism, Adam smith, Face (sociological concept), Art history and History.

OpenAlex records 61 citations. That places it in the top 1% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2002 with 7 citing works. Notable citing venues include Archaeological Dialogues, Cambridge University Press eBooks and Palgrave Macmillan UK eBooks. The citing works include 42 journal articles, 12 book chapters, 2 books and 2 dissertations. They come from 9 countries, led by the United Kingdom, the United States and France.

It is recorded in 3 library collections.
